      • getElements

        @NonNull
List<ElementT> getElements()
        The elements in the page.

      • getPageNumber

        int getPageNumber()
        The page number (1 for the first page, 2 for the second page, etc).

        Note that it may be different than the number you passed to OffsetPager.getPage(PagingIterable, int): if the result set was too short, this is the actual number of the last page.

      • isLast

        boolean isLast()
        Whether this is the last page in the result set.
